text.A New Thing You Need to Know Before Comi: Jambo Jipya Unalohitaji Kufahamu Kabla ya Kuja Japani
text.These days, there's one character you'll: Siku hizi, kuna mhusika mmoja utamwona kila mahali nchini Japani: Chiikawa. 🐰

text.Japan already has Doraemon, Pikachu, and: Japani tayari ina Doraemon, Pikachu, na Super Mario Bros., lakini siku hizi, nchi inafurika kwa Chiikawa.
